about: Spec D11 (docs/specs/03-rebuild-screens.md): for every per-test node of protected_tests.json, the SHA-256 of what in its own file decides, from outside its own source, whether and how it runs: the module's statements that touch pytestmark, its module-level fixtures (autouse or not; matched by the decorator's callee, fixture, or an autouse= argument) and xunit module and function setup and teardown, and, for a path::Class::name node in a test file, the enclosing class's header (decorators, bases) and every statement of its body that is not a test_* test (fixtures, setup and teardown methods, attributes, pytestmark). A class in a file pytest does not collect (live_verify's Command) is no test class, so only its module part counts. The SHA-256 of nothing (e3b0c442...) means the node had none of these. Written once from the ref below with tools/protected_tests.py --context --ref 045978b --json; never regenerated in Phase 3. tests/test_protected_tests.py recomputes each hash from the working tree.
